chatpipe-export 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Export any AI chat session to Markdown, JSON, or plain text using simple commands.
- Supports a variety of sources: OpenClaw, Hermes agent logs, ChatGPT exports, Chatbox HTML/JSON, and plain text/Markdown files.
- Auto-detects input formats and converts for Obsidian, Notion, ChatGPT, Chatbox, and more.
- Easy one-click or command-line exports for current or historical sessions.
- Exports are saved to the workspace root with clear, descriptive filenames.
